metadata.name: v0.8.0 post-calibration holdout
metadata.note: Authored and labelled from docs/triage-policy.md after policy implementation; not derived from production phrase dictionaries, existing semantic fixtures, the frozen 81-ticket corpus, or the known mismatch list.

cases.text: One teacher's attendance screen is blank, but the registrar can use the paper roll and enter it at close of day.

labelBasis.rationale: One-person inconvenience with a complete same-process workaround and no stated cutoff.

cases.text: The science portal is unavailable for fourteen classes, but teachers can switch to printed instructions until tomorrow morning.

labelBasis.rationale: A cohort-level outage remains consequential, while a complete stopgap and tomorrow morning create Medium urgency.

cases.text: Finance would like the new receipt export by Friday if possible; existing receipts continue to work.

labelBasis.rationale: Finance vocabulary and a preference do not establish harm or a hard cutoff.

cases.text: The statutory attendance return is due in four days; the export omits one required field and there is no alternate report.

labelBasis.rationale: A defective compliance export has a committed four-day requirement, but no High consequence is stated.

cases.text: The overnight archive completed at 2am; please explain the retention entry in the log for our records.

labelBasis.rationale: Completed scheduled behaviour and a documentation question have no active failure.

cases.text: A draft permissions change could expose counsellor notes to another department if approved; nothing has been deployed.

labelBasis.rationale: The potential exposure is credible but conditional and not active.

cases.text: A parent can currently see a different child's medical note in the family portal.

labelBasis.rationale: Cross-person disclosure is active exposure with an ongoing privacy consequence.

cases.text: The emergency contact list is missing from the tablet used on today's excursion; staff are carrying the current printed list.

labelBasis.rationale: Safety-critical information is unavailable during today's activity; the paper copy preserves operations but not the digital control.

cases.text: A former contractor can still sign in to the welfare dashboard, which contains student case notes, because access removal has not completed.

labelBasis.rationale: An excluded person retains live access to sensitive records, so exposure is active.

cases.text: The payroll preview has a column-formatting error, but the pay file was accepted and every employee was paid.

labelBasis.rationale: Payroll is domain context; successful processing and paid employees provide no active financial consequence.

cases.text: Seven employees were omitted from today's payroll file and finance cannot rerun it before the cutoff.

labelBasis.rationale: A confirmed same-day payroll processing failure risks missed pay at the cutoff.

cases.text: The canteen charged two families twice; finance has isolated the accounts and will refund them manually next week.

labelBasis.rationale: Confirmed duplicate charges are consequential but contained and recoverable without a same-day cutoff.

cases.text: A sync wrote the wrong bus route to forty student profiles, but the job is disabled and records can be restored from yesterday's export.

labelBasis.rationale: Wrong data affected a cohort but propagation is contained and a restoration path exists.

cases.text: The only copy of twelve exam submissions was overwritten; the storage snapshot is corrupt and recovery has failed.

labelBasis.rationale: Material assessment data is permanently lost; no immediate deadline is stated, so Urgency remains Medium.

cases.text: The same timetable change returns after every overnight sync at one campus; staff correct it each morning.

labelBasis.rationale: A recurring one-campus data fault has cumulative consequence but no stated immediate cutoff.

cases.text: An import is still duplicating enrolments for three campuses; clerks are correcting records while it runs.

labelBasis.rationale: Active multi-campus propagation raises Impact and supplies a bounded Medium urgency floor.

cases.text: The high-availability connector is named in the ticket, but the only fault is a typo in a local report filter.

labelBasis.rationale: Critical-system identity and platform metadata cannot manufacture consequence.

cases.text: The identity gateway is unavailable for everyone at one school, lessons begin in forty-five minutes, and there is no alternate sign-in.

labelBasis.rationale: A whole-school access failure blocks teaching immediately with a near operational deadline and no workaround.

cases.text: The wellbeing team requests a dashboard of historical contacts; there is no incident and the existing report remains usable.

labelBasis.rationale: This is a non-urgent reporting request with an existing usable path.

cases.text: A screen-reader user cannot reach the submit button, but a support officer can complete the form on their behalf.

labelBasis.rationale: A workaround preserves completion but the accessibility barrier retains a Medium urgency floor.

cases.text: A safety checklist export is wrong for one laboratory; the inspection is next month and current paper records are available.

labelBasis.rationale: The safety context has a reliable current paper path and a future inspection, not an immediate exposure.

cases.text: The compliance archive can be restored from the weekly snapshot, but the audit window closes in two days.

labelBasis.rationale: Recoverable archive loss has a committed two-day audit deadline without an active breach.

cases.text: The mobile app was unavailable for twenty minutes yesterday; it has been stable since and no records were lost.

labelBasis.rationale: The availability incident is historical and explicitly resolved with no loss.

cases.text: A staff member thinks a confidential case note may have been visible, but logs are still being checked and no viewer is confirmed.

labelBasis.rationale: Potential exposure is credible and material but not confirmed active exposure.

cases.text: The mobile lesson view is slow for one teacher, while the desktop browser completes the same lesson normally.

labelBasis.rationale: A single-user degradation has a complete equivalent path and no deadline.

cases.text: The grant reporting file is due tomorrow under a funding rule; the export cannot be generated and there is no manual alternative.

labelBasis.rationale: A blocked compliance deliverable has a committed tomorrow deadline; consequence is significant but not an active safety/privacy breach.
